qualification.details: Master's Degree with at least 60% marks in any discipline in Biological Sciences/Biotechnology/Pharmaceutical Sciences/Chemistry. Applicant must be qualified in any one of the following tests: CSIR/UGC/ICMR including Lectureship (Assistant Professorship) OR GATE. National Level examination DST, DBT, MoE, ICMR etc. Desirable: Experience in working with Animal Models.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the ARI Pune Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 15-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of ARI Pune to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ARI Pune Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Junior Research Fellow position at ARI Pune is 15th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree with at least 60% marks in Biological Sciences/Biotechnology/Pharmaceutical Sciences/Chemistry and have qualified in CSIR/UGC/ICMR/GATE or a similar national-level examination.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow post is 28 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the ARI Pune Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official website of ARI Pune before the last date of application.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for the ARI Pune Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, a non-refundable application fee of Rs. 100/- is applicable for General/OBC/EWS/Divyang/Women candidates. SC/ST/Divyang/Women candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position will be based on an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Temporary.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is ADVT/RecT/ANRF/13/SP-363/2026-27.

faq.question: Q10. Where is Agharkar Research Institute located?
faq.answer: Agharkar Research Institute is located in Pune, Maharashtra, with the pincode 411004.
